{{short description|German bryologist and phytogeographer|bot=PearBOT 5}}
'''Wolfgang Frey''' (born 14 August 1942 in [[Rechberghausen]]) is a [[Germans|German]] [[bryology|bryologist]] and [[Phytogeography|phytogeographer]].<ref>{{cite book|last = Brummitt|first = R. K.|author2=C. E. Powell |title = Authors of Plant Names |publisher = [[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]] |year = 1992 |isbn = 1-84246-085-4}}</ref>

In 2007, a ''[[Festschrift]]'' was published in honor of Frey.<ref>{{cite book |editor1-last=Kürschner |editor1-first=Harald |editor2-last=Pfeiffer |editor2-first=Tanja |editor3-last=Stech |editor3-first=Michael |title=Festschrift to Wolfgang Frey--a scientist's life between 'deserts' and 'rain forests' |date=2007 |publisher=J. Cramer |location=Berlin |isbn=978-3-443-51053-4}}</ref>
